description_en: Associates an Elastic IP address (EIP) with a cloud service instance in the same region
description_zh: 调用AssociateEipAddress将弹性公网IP（EIP）绑定到同地域的云产品实例上
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-eip-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --allocation-id eip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --instance-id i-2zebb08phyczzawe0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateEipAddress

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the EIP that you want to associate with an instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定云产品实例的EIP所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP that you want to associate with an instance
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance to which you want to attach the EIP.

You can enter the instance ID of a NAT gateway, a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance for load balancing, a cloud server ECS instance, an instance ID of a secondary elastic network interface controller (NIC), an instance ID of a high availability virtual IP address, or an IP address
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定EIP的实例ID。

支持输入NAT网关实例ID、传统型负载均衡CLB实例ID、云服务器ECS实例ID、辅助弹性网卡实例ID、高可用虚拟IP实例ID、IP地址
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance to which you want to attach the EIP. Valid values:

Nat: NAT gateway.

SlbInstance: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) for load balancing.

EcsInstance (default): cloud server ECS.

NetworkInterface: secondary elastic network interface controller (NIC).

HaVip: high availability virtual IP address. 

IpAddress: IP address.

By default, the instance type is EcsInstance. If you want to attach the EIP to an instance of a different type, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定EIP的实例的类型，取值：

Nat：NAT网关。

SlbInstance：传统型负载均衡CLB。

EcsInstance（默认值）：云服务器ECS。

NetworkInterface：辅助弹性网卡。

HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。 

IpAddress：IP地址。

默认要绑定EIP的实例类型为EcsInstance，如果您需要绑定EIP的实例类型不为EcsInstance，则该值必填
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance to which you want to attach the EIP.

This parameter is required only when the EIP is added to an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance that uses shared bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定EIP的实例所属地域的ID。

仅在EIP加入到带宽共享型全球加速实例后，才需要填写该参数
parameters.name: instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
An IP address within the vSwitch CIDR block.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically allocates a private IP address based on the VPC ID and vSwitch ID.
This parameter is required when InstanceType is set to NetworkInterface. You must specify the private IP address to be attached
parameters.help_zh:
交换机网段内的一个IP地址。

如果不输入该参数，系统根据VPC ID和交换机ID自动分配一个私网IP地址。
当InstanceType配置为NetworkInterface时，该参数必填，需输入要绑定的私网IP
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The association mode. Valid values:

NAT (default): NAT mode (standard mode).

MULTI_BINDED: multi-EIP to ENI mode.

BINDED: EIP to ENI mode.


This parameter is required only when InstanceType is set to NetworkInterface
parameters.help_zh:
绑定模式，取值：

NAT（默认值）：NAT模式（普通模式）。

MULTI_BINDED：多EIP网卡可见模式。

BINDED：EIP网卡可见模式。


仅InstanceType配置为NetworkInterface时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC that has the IPv4 gateway feature enabled and is in the same region as the EIP.

When you attach an EIP to an IP address, the system can enable public network access for the attached IP address based on the routing configurations of the VPC.

This parameter is required when InstanceType is set to IpAddress, which means you want to attach the EIP to an IP address
parameters.help_zh:
开通了IPv4网关功能且与EIP同地域的VPC ID。

EIP绑定IP地址时，系统可以根据该VPC的路由配置，使绑定的IP地址具备公网访问能力。

InstanceType取值为IpAddress时，即要绑定EIP的实例类型为IP地址时，该参数必填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
